turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I finally want to patch the hole my kid put in the hallway wall.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oh no. How big is it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: About the size of a fist.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then you can use a mesh patch kit or cut in a small piece of new drywall. Which sounds more like you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a second, my roommate wants to ask me something. I'll let you know when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Window or aisle? I'm booking our seats now.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Aisle. You know I drink a litre of water on every flight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then I'm getting the window and you're not climbing over me.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Deal. Is there food included or do we bring snacks?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Says here a light meal. Light meaning a cracker, probably.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Bring snacks then. And get the seats near the front if they're free.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine, skip it. We're not in a rush anyway.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. You were choosing between a mesh patch and new drywall for the hole in the hallway.
